# Plate position matching fixture

`plate-10.stl` is the locally generated OpenSCAD mesh of the repository's
[plate fixture](../../../skills/cad-format-translator/fixtures/plate.scad).
The fixture uses millimetres, with a 60 × 40 × 10 mm plate and a 10 mm
through-hole centred at (17, 23) mm in the XY plane. The saved mesh bytes
are unchanged. SHA-256: `e0b2c18b6af085df41c60c4d4c548d4849fe5114ae8be70b08b3dc8ab60288c9`.
